reason: Compile-time proof that the served rpc group cannot carry two procedures with one tag: a group extending a feature cannot reuse a name of that feature's commands or queries, a hand-typed tag cannot sit on a procedure a feature serves, two hand-made groups cannot serve one tag, and two features cannot carry one name. Every pragma goes unused, and the build fails, if any guarantee is ever relaxed.

Compile-time proof of the three guarantees the journal kit's types carry: a command's rows handle is read-only, a feature's every fact has exactly one materializer, AlreadyDone is not in the error type the rpc client hands a caller, and an app never carries two features with one name. Every pragma goes unused, and the build fails, if any guarantee is ever relaxed.
